name: O-RAN Testbed Automation (NIST)
description: Automation tool for deploying 5G Open RAN (O-RAN) testbeds from NIST Wireless Networks Division. Integrates OAI RAN, 5G core, and RIC components.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker-based deployment automation. Includes OAI gNB, UE, Near-RT RIC (Flexible-RIC), and 5G core network components. Uses 5gdeploy for core network.

eval_notes: NIST-backed automation for full O-RAN testbed. Supports both OSC RIC and FlexRIC. Very actively maintained (2026). Good reference for reproducible O-RAN deployments. Complete O-RAN testbed with automated deployment. Includes RIC, gNB, UE, and core. NIST-backed reference implementation. Excellent for O-RAN integration and xApp testing evals.
